_about.what: Schema and worked example for the honeyfleet bench harness.
_about.discipline: Every example value here is either honeyfleet's own measurement or an anonymised aggregate. Per MODULE-CONTRACT rule 7 this repository carries no real IPs, domains, keys or tokens — so attacker addresses, ASN names and host identities that appear in the operator's own evidence are NOT reproduced here.
_about.sanitisation: IPs use RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24); ports are illustrative; the attack figures are the aggregate counts only.
_about.how_to_use: Copy to data/telemetry.json and fill the placeholders with your own collector output, then run: python3 bench/charts.py

source: your own collective evidence — kept out of tree, see _about.discipline
meta.note: Aggregate attack counts come from one forensic window on a single two-node deployment. They are a snapshot, not a 30-day attack rate.

asn_clusters.note: compromised cloud VMs turned into bots

attack_intel.worm_capture: One interactive honeypot session delivered a ~100-line multi-stage Mirai/Gafgyt dropper (directory walk -> kill cloud-security processes -> fetch payload -> rewrite wget/curl -> disable firewall, clear logs). It ran entirely inside the honeypot sandbox; the real host was unaffected.

stages.evidence: the 70 unique hostile IPs above are overwhelmingly automated
55+ IPs in sustained brute force (dictionaries, weak credentials, automation)
one real login, worm payload delivered
payload download + cloud-protection kill + log wipe, all isolated

honeypot_funnel.note: The nulls are deliberate: the harness prints no estimate for a stage it has not measured. Fill them from your own collector run.

jails.note: escalating ban on the real port

ban_system.note: 54 of 70 IPs re-offended after a ban and escalated into recidive — bans are not the end of the story

fleet.topology: main (central: monitors, real sshd, honeypot) <-- agent (snapshot push)
fleet.known_hosts_tripwire: honeypot host key != real-port host key; a script that lands on 22 fails hard (tripwire armed)

resource_snapshot.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 — official release binary / apt package, really installed and run, snapshot once the processes had settled

vps_fit.note: central + many nodes alongside other services

resource_snapshot.note: Snapshot values, not 30-day means or peaks — the sustained curve is what bench/collector.sh is for.
